name: io.foodsafetydata/usda-establishments
title: FoodSafetyData.io
description: Look up the USDA plant behind any meat or poultry package code: FSIS Salmonella categories, recalls.

tools.name: lookup_establishment
tools.description:
Resolve a USDA inspection code from a package label (e.g. P12345,
    M12345, I135 or a company name) to its establishment: plant name,
    company, location, status, Salmonella verification categories per
    product class, and recall history.

tools.name: get_safety_profile
tools.description:
Full public-data profile for one establishment: registry identity,
    Salmonella verification history, lab sampling results, recalls, and a
    neutral reported-status summary with the USDA source URLs behind it.

tools.name: search_establishments
tools.description:
Search the USDA establishment registry by inspection code, company
    or plant name, or city — returns matching establishments with codes
    and profile URLs.
